decisions.reason: The medical examination light remains an adjacent but specialized option, so absent clear negative evidence management would keep it, though its non-core niche makes it more exposed to later pruning than the firm's industrial and office lines.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires strongly leverage the firm's certified engineering, industrial customer base and multi-model line logic, so this option is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
The designer task light is a close-to-core product that was relaunched as a popular item, making continued retention more likely than withdrawal.
The pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core professional building-lighting business, but as a newer single product it carries some portfolio-rationalization risk if overlap emerges.
The premium pendant luminaire line matches the firm's quality-led positioning and offers enough breadth as a product line to justify keeping the option open.
